listenings.text: Luiz, it's Diane. Two follow-ups from last night. Nora Whitfield has already asked for your email, so I have sent it. She has never worked with a Brazilian supplier before, and she wants to talk about the harvest calendar. Second, Tom Baker has just joined the board and he has not met the credit team yet. I have put you next to him on Thursday. Same room, seven o'clock. Do not prepare slides. He hates them.

Luiz, this is Tom Baker. Diane has already given me your number, so forgive the direct call. I have just come from the plant in Rio Verde, and I have not seen the south region yet. Thursday is my first real conversation with anybody in credit. I have read the aging report and I do not want it again. Bring me one customer instead. Any customer, with a name. And I have never eaten dinner at seven in Brazil. Tell me if that is too early.
